newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil industrial production down in Oct-IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil industrial production down in Oct-IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian industrial production in October fell 0.2 percent from September and rose 8.3 percent on October 1995, the government's National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
The IBGE said the industrial sector was likely to continue its moderate growth over the next few months.
Industrial production in the January-to-September period rose 0.4 percent, the first positive result since January 1996, the IBGE said in a statement.
Output in October decreased in 11 of the 20 industrial sectors covered in the IBGE survey, with transport materials down 4.8 percent, tobacco down 3.4 percent and plastic materials down 2.8 percent.
Output of durable consumer goods declined in October by one percent, while capital goods expanded 3.2 percent and production of semi- and non-durable goods rose 0.7 percent, the IBGE said.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
